extracted.name: Smoked trout & horseradish pâté
extracted.description: Whizz up this fish dip with hot tangy mustard notes, cream cheese, lemon and dill - great for a last minute party dish
ingredient_lines: 1 tbsp finely chopped dill plus extra fronds to serve
1 Baby Gem lettuce leaves separated, to serve
instruction_lines: Put the cream cheese, horseradish, and lemon zest and juice in a bowl, and mix together until smooth. Season.

Add the chopped dill and flake in the smoked trout, removing any bones or skin as you go. Stir well to combine and add more seasoning to taste. The pâté will keep in the fridge for up to 2 days. Serve garnished with dill fronds and sprinkled with cracked black pepper. Eat with rye bread and lettuce leaves.
